preconditions.description: The dimensions of the board and the number of chips are within the specified range.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= sx_i <= n and 1 <= sy_i <= m for sx_i, sy_i in zip(sx, sy))
preconditions.description: Each chip's starting position is within the board's boundaries.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= fx_i <= n and 1 <= fy_i <= m for fx_i, fy_i in zip(fx, fy))
preconditions.description: Each chip's target position is within the board's boundaries.

postconditions.description: The number of operations is either -1 (indicating impossibility) or within the allowed range.

postconditions.expression: return_value[0] == -1 or all(any((sx_i + dx, sy_i + dy) == (fx_i, fy_i) for dx, dy in [(-1, 0), (1, 0), (0, -1), (0, 1)]) for sx_i, sy_i, fx_i, fy_i in zip(sx, sy, fx, fy))
postconditions.description: Each chip must visit its target position at least once if the sequence of operations is possible.
